entries.name: tftp
entries.note: TFTP is the packaged tftp-hpa daemon and client (runtime-packages.txt), off by default like the reference.
entries.ready_note: TFTP is the packaged tftp-hpa (server in.tftpd and the tftp client, listed in runtime-packages.txt); the reference keeps it off by default as BifrOSt does (no unit is enabled). The paths are those the Arch package installs and are not yet verified on a built image.
